grammar: Explicit named preparation scopes attached to individual selectors; catalog-exact positive labels; operating-phase flow, endpoints, formulation, volume, pressure and principle requests; positive requests and restrictions in the same sentence are separate instructions. Typed exclusions retain their selectors and known owners; observations and explicitly unknown columns retain literal provenance. Unsupported substantive fragments prevent full-inventory reporting.
normalization: Accent-insensitive casefolded matching with Unicode code-point index mapping; immutable original UTF-8 text and literal origins; same-unit decimal punctuation only.
dispatch: One unchanged StructuredControl.evaluate invocation at most; unresolved owners and ambiguous restrictions are preblocked; supported semantic conflicts go to the core.
defaults: No inferred supplied column from product labels, no unit conversion, no guessed product or task identity. General method principles do not require a product or column.
source_policy: The unchanged structured adapter is authoritative; caller text cannot approve E118-I or E121-EQ.
test_boundaries: Preclassified ledgers and injected faults are internal test fixtures only, not public caller keys or example-ID routing.
